summary: Comprehensive smoke test of Nabd Admin Dashboard. All 64 sidebar nav routes (matching the 62 routes in renderPage + 2 extra nav entries) opened and rendered without any console errors, page errors, or React runtime errors. RTL Arabic + Cairo font + dark theme correctly applied. TopBar buttons (Emergency, Kill Switches, Notifications bell, sidebar collapse) all functional. Ctrl+K global search opens modal, typing 'مستشفى' filters and shows مستشفى الرحمة التخصصي; typing 'أحمد' shows أحمد محمد الزهراني — search filter from MOCK data works correctly.

routes_tested.note: emergency-orders is a PlaceholderPage as designed (renderPage line 4606). It is NOT in NAV array (intentional) so unreachable via sidebar — main agent can verify by calling setPage('emergency-orders').

topbar_and_global.emergency_button: OK — navigates to emergency-live, blink animation working
topbar_and_global.ctrl_k_search: OK — modal opens, search filters MOCK providers + patients correctly

critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/src/App.js is a single 4,801-line file containing 60+ screens — exceeds the >700-line maintainability threshold by 7x. Recommend splitting into /src/pages/* modules (one file per top-level screen) for long-term maintainability. Not blocking — by design per user's instruction to not refactor.

All API endpoints in /app/frontend/src/api/endpoints.js are unused skeleton placeholders — entire dashboard runs on hard-coded MOCK object. Expected at this stage but flagged so it's not forgotten when wiring real APIs.

Inline <link> tag for Google Fonts is rendered inside <div> in the App component body (line 4662) instead of <head>. Browsers tolerate this but it's invalid HTML; move to public/index.html (Cairo is already preloaded there, so this line can simply be removed).

Nav items in the sidebar lack data-testid attributes — automated testing currently has to rely on label-text matching. Adding data-testid={`nav-${item.id}`} on each clickable nav div would dramatically improve test stability.
TopBar buttons (Emergency, Kill Switches, bell, collapse toggle) and KPI cards also lack data-testid attributes — same recommendation.
test_credentials: Not applicable — no auth screen, app loads directly into dashboard with hardcoded role SUPER_ADMIN
seed_data_creation: None — all data is MOCK in-memory
context_for_next_testing_agent: First-pass smoke test passed cleanly. When real APIs are wired by main agent: (1) add data-testid attrs to nav items + topbar buttons + KPI cards to enable robust selector-based testing; (2) the renderPage map has 63 routes vs NAV has 64 items — verify all NAV ids map to a component (currently they do, 'emergency-orders' is the only renderPage key without a NAV entry, used as placeholder). Backend testing will need new pytest suite once endpoints in /app/frontend/src/api/endpoints.js get implemented backend-side.
